ledger.x: 1958: the Fifth Republic begins on 4 October under the constitution of Charles de Gaulle.
1958: France holds its sector of Berlin as one of the Western Allies.
1958: Madagascar enters the French Community as an autonomous state, drawn as a client of France.

1958: French Cameroun, a United Nations trust territory administered by France, is associated with (not a member of) the new French Community; drawn as a client of France from the Fifth Republic's founding.

1958: French Togoland, a United Nations trust territory administered by France, is associated with (not a member of) the new French Community; drawn as a client of France from the Fifth Republic's founding.

wars.name: Algerian War
wars.outcome: "Algerian victory" (infobox, 1 November 1954 - 19 March 1962): the Evian Accords, approved by the French electorate on 8 April 1962 and by the Algerian referendum of 1 July 1962, gave independence, proclaimed on 5 July 1962.

certainty.note: Researcher's judgment, no page opened on frontiers: the African, Malagasy and Saharan colonial boundaries were administrative lines; metropolitan France and the departments are sharp.
Metropolitan frontiers and overseas coasts are treaty and survey lines; the Saharan and Caribbean/Pacific islands are small enough to be sharp.
